target: vascular bundle (PO_0005020) with has position median (FLOPO:0991381), pattern 18
reason: 'middle 3 stout' counts the median veins of a multi-veined organ (glume, lemma, bract), not the single midrib; so neither leaf midvein PO_0020139 nor a synonym of it. PO_0005020 has exact synonym 'vein'; 'middle' is a listed word for median. No positioned class 'median vascular bundle' exists yet.

An architectural growth unit (sympodial unit) of a pseudorhizome. It names a kind of growth, not an anatomical structure. The nearest classes (shoot axis PO_0025029, rhizome PO_0004542) would misread it, and two floras do not justify a class.
Fragment of a proportion ('ca. 1/2 their length'); length is a quality (size), not a part.

Exact: 'seed' after the preposition. In 'covering 1/2 of seed' the seed is the reference whole, not the bearer: the bearer is the covering structure (aril). The fraction is a count on a named fraction, which pattern 14 holds.

label: floral spur
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is part of a flower (PO:0009046) and is a slender, hollow, usually nectar-containing extension of a sepal, a petal, the calyx or the corolla.
reason: In flower descriptions 'spur' (here holding the nectary) is a floral spur. The PO_lexicon synonym 'spur' points to short shoot PO_0004701, which is wrong in this context. PO has only petal spur PO_0025511 (cardinal organ part) and corolla spur PO_0025512 (collective organ part structure); sepal and calyx spurs (Impatiens, Tropaeolum, Delphinium) and spurs of unstated origin have no class. Propose to PO upstream as the common parent of PO_0025511 and PO_0025512. Until then, a floral context should stop 'spur' from grounding to short shoot.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark leaf lamina margin (PO_0025009); counted part leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517)
reason: Lobes counted on the side of a pinna or pinnule facing the frond apex. Acroscopic is a side, not one of the nine bearer positions; the record carries no phenotype class, as pattern 14 says.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark pinnule (FLOPO_0985028) with has position basal (FLOPO:0991002)
reason: Sori counted on one named lobe of a pinnule. The landmark can only be given broader (the pinnule or its lobe); 'acroscopic' has no position class. A new class for this lobe is not justified.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517) with has position basal (FLOPO:0991002)
reason: Same construction as the previous item, with 'segment' meaning a lobe of a fern pinna. 'Acroscopic' is lost; no new term.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517) with has position basal (FLOPO:0991002)
reason: 'Auriculate' is a quality of the lobe, and 'basal' is a listed position. The part is a basal leaf lamina lobe.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark pinnule (FLOPO_0985028) with has position basal (FLOPO:0991002)
reason: 'Sori 1-3 on basal pinnule': sori (PO_0025359) counted on the basal pinnule. Pinnule exists in FLOPO, and basal is a pattern-18 position.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind at_region, landmark leaf lamina margin (PO_0025009); counted part leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517)
reason: The counterpart of 'on acroscopic margin' (the side facing the frond base). Treat both the same way.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind each_side, landmark leaf sheath (PO_0020104)
reason: In bamboos, 'oral setae 1 or 2 on each shoulder' means the setae stand on each side of the summit of the (culm) sheath. The shoulder is the sheath apex on either side, so the count is per side; no class for 'shoulder' is needed.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind each_side, landmark vascular bundle (PO_0005020)
reason: The same wording as the pattern's own example ('on each side of the midrib'). The previous review grounded costule to vascular bundle (C394).
Pronoun or anaphora ('2 others slightly apart'); not a part name.

The earlier review rejected 'bristle' as a generic part that needs its organ. The bristles may be pappus elements (PO_0025394), perianth bristles (FLOPO_0986044) or setae. With the organ given, it would be the part with has position outer (FLOPO:0991379).

target: apex region of outer involucral bract (FLOPO_0996010)
reason: 'Outer phyllary' is an exact synonym of the positioned part FLOPO_0996010, and the apex is a region the patterns express as a part of the qualified whole. Obtuse and flat apply to it.

target: leaf lamina vein (PO_0020138), counted at a position (pattern 14), landmark the basal veins (PO_0020138)
reason: 'Basal veins with 3-6 outer secondary veins' means the veins branching from the outer (abmedial) side of the basal veins. It is narrower than leaf lamina vein. 'Outer' here is a side of the landmark, not the bearer position FLOPO:0991379.
A lemmatisation error for 'series'. 'Outer series 3-5' is a whorl of phyllaries, tepals, staminodes or pappus, and the organ is not named.
Same as 'outer bristle': generic bristle without its organ. 'Outermost' maps to outer (FLOPO:0991379) once the organ is known.
A quality of the arrangement of leaflets ('overlapping pairs'), not a part.

target: papilla cell (PO_0025166)
reason: Exact for the part, as in the previous review (C269, C391). The number counts rows, not papillae: the count should be held, or recorded as an arrangement, rather than as the papilla count. A row of papillae is not a class.
'Segment' and 'fertile' were rejected before (generic part; not a structure). The organ the segment belongs to is not named.

word: per fertile, forked and pouch-shaped segment
reason: A generic segment with three qualities; the organ is not named.

target: leaf lamina (PO_0020039)
reason: Exact (label word). 'Bulbils usually 1 per lamina' is an ordinary count with leaf lamina as the container.

target: count at a position (pattern 14), kind per_node, landmark shoot axis node (PO_0005004) with has position lower (FLOPO:0991377)
reason: 'Branches 3-5 per lower node': per_node is a kind of place in pattern 14, and 'lower' is a pattern-18 position. 'Per node' was rejected in the earlier review, which predates pattern 14.

target: carpel (PO_0009030)
reason: 'Pistil' is a synonym of carpel in PO. In the 'staminodes 4 or 5 per pistil' example the staminodes surround the pistil and are not part of it. That makes this a count at a position (each pistillate flower), not a count with the carpel as container.

word: per primary lobe or secondary lobe
target: leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517)
reason: Narrower: primary and secondary lobes are lobes of different orders. It is a count of veinlets with the lobe as container; the 'or' joins two orders of the same class.

target: branch (PO_0025073)
reason: Exact: 'twig' is a synonym of branch in PO. It is a count with branch as the container.

target: pinnule (FLOPO_0985028)
reason: Narrower: the ultimate pinnule is the last-order division of the frond, and 'or segment' names the same last division. There is no ultimate-order class, and none is needed.

target: branch (PO_0025073)
reason: Narrower: a last-order branch ('twig' is a synonym of branch). 'Leaves 3-7 per ultimate twig' is a count with branch as the container.
